title: WPA band and having no favorite tune or special keys
summary: He never played with the WPA band and has no favorite tune or key; he plays whatever is written.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Did you ever play with the WPA band?
Who me? No I never did. No I never did.
Your own records that you've made. Which one is your favorite of all the tunes that you've played?
The records we made? I mean the last ones we made?
No I mean for all the time.

Oh but I never had no specials then. No specials? No no specials. Like some people say this number is special number. I feel any number that I play. I play good and sound good to me what I feel. I feel all the same things that sound good to me. I don't have no specials. Like some people say don't you have special keys to take solos in. I don't do it like that. If a key is written in the solo, I play it. I play it. I play it. I play it. Don't have any modulation no key. Play it right there. Oh yeah. See? Some parts you got the modulation to the key. You understand? The band with the key. Then you got the modulation back to the key.
